lines.text: Every single follower we get adds one planet to our universe.
This is our TikTok right now. Three followers. Three.
So here they are. Three planets. Three lonely little planets.
Our poor universe looks very empty right now.
Let's see how fast we can fill this sky. A hundred is the goal.
Follow us, and your planet joins the orbit in the next video.
Orbi Transfer. Your planet is next!
